title: Open the Center
setup: Both sides have pushed their d- and e-pawns, and all four now meet in the center.
hint: When four center pawns touch, the first capture decides who gets the open lines. Which one also opens a file toward Black's queen?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{dxe5}} takes the e-pawn and opens the d-file. If Black answers {{dxe4}}, then {{Qxd8+}} trades queens with check, Black's king has to take back and loses the right to castle, and the pawn on e4 is cut off from its friends. {{exd5}} instead lets {{Qxd5}} recapture with a queen in the center.

When center pawns meet, capture where the file you open works for you.
